faqs.q: Sec. 2-262. - Procedure for adoption of administrative fees.
faqs.a:
(a)
Publication.
Proposed fees shall be submitted to the city manager for approval. Before becoming
               effective, such fees shall be published in accordance with either of the two methods
               set forth in subsections (1) and (2) of this section. The city manager or his designee,
               as the adopting authority, shall select the method of publication.
(1)
By publishing the fees in full as finally adopted once in a newspaper of general circulation
               of the city; or
(2)
By filing a total of five copies of the fees as follows: three copies of the fees
               with the city clerk, one copy with the city attorney, and, if applicable, one copy
               with the department head responsible for establishing such fees. If this method of
               publication is adopted, there shall be published a notice stating that the filings
               have been made, and setting forth dates of such filings. Such notice shall be published
               once in a newspaper of general circulation.
(b)
Public inspection.
The adopting authority and the city clerk shall make such fees available for public
               inspection at all reasonable times.
(c)
Authority to adopt.
No officer, employee, agent, board or commission or member thereof of the city shall
               have power or authority to adopt any fees except under the authority or specific provision
               of statutes or ordinances of the city.
(Code 1981, § 2-182; Ord. No. 3219, § 1, 10-23-1995)
